goalOneSentence: Read the seeded InventoryApi ASP.NET minimal-API source and produce a structured test-readiness profile covering all HTTP surfaces with file:line citations, plus a QUESTIONS.md with residual reachability unknowns.

tasks.title: Analyze InventoryApi source and write sut-profile.md
tasks.description:
The working directory contains a seeded SUT at sut/InventoryApi/. Read every file in that folder carefully before writing anything. Write qaas-analysis/sut-profile.md with ALL of the following sections:

**Section 1 — Protocols & Surfaces** (required Markdown table with columns: Surface, Method, Route, Request DTO, Response, Citation). List ALL THREE endpoints found in sut/InventoryApi/Program.cs: (a) GET /inventory/items — returns list of all items, no request body; (b) GET /inventory/items/{id} — path parameter id (string), returns single InventoryItem or 404 JSON; (c) POST /inventory/reserve — request body is ReserveRequest record (ItemId: string, Quantity: int) defined in sut/InventoryApi/Models/ReserveRequest.cs, returns { reserved, remaining } or 404/400 JSON. Every table row MUST include a file:line citation — write the actual line number where app.MapGet or app.MapPost appears in Program.cs.

**Section 2 — Configuration** (required Markdown table with columns: EnvVar, Default, Source Citation). Must include at minimum: INVENTORY_PORT with default value 8085, citing Program.cs at the line where Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable('INVENTORY_PORT') appears.

**Section 3 — Test-Relevant Behaviors**. Free-form bullet list: describe the in-memory inventory store (no database persistence, store resets on restart), the POST /inventory/reserve state-mutation behavior (order of tests matters), the 404/400 error paths, and explicitly state that the SUT has NO downstream dependencies (no database connection, no message broker) — therefore MOCK_REQUIRED: NO — the QaaS runner can call this SUT directly without a mocker.

**Section 4 — Open Questions**. Bullet list of at least 2 items that the source code CANNOT answer: where is the SUT deployed during tests? what value will INVENTORY_PORT be set to in the test environment?

Do NOT produce any YAML, csproj, or code files. Analysis markdown only.
acceptanceCriteria: INVENTORY_PORT with default 8085 present in Configuration table
Every endpoint row cites Program.cs with a line number
rubric: All 3 HTTP surfaces listed with correct methods and routes
INVENTORY_PORT with default 8085 in Configuration table
Every endpoint row carries a file:line citation referencing Program.cs
MOCK_REQUIRED: NO stated (SUT has no downstream deps)
No invented endpoints, env vars, or downstream dependencies
failureModes: Omitting POST /inventory/reserve from the surfaces table
Missing file:line citations — citations are mandatory per the description
Fabricating a downstream database or message broker dependency
Claiming a mocker is required when the SUT has no downstream services

tasks.title: Write reachability and environment QUESTIONS.md
tasks.description: Several facts about running the InventoryApi SUT in a test environment cannot be determined from source code alone. Write qaas-analysis/QUESTIONS.md containing AT LEAST 3 numbered, machine-usable questions. Required questions (paraphrase as needed): (1) Where will the InventoryApi SUT be running during test execution — is it started manually before the runner, started by CI, or does the QaaS runner launch it via a hook? (2) What value will INVENTORY_PORT be set to in the test environment — is the default 8085 acceptable, or is a different port assigned? (3) Are the in-memory inventory items (ITM-001, ITM-002, ITM-003) freshly initialized per test run, or must tests pre-seed data via a fixture mechanism? You may add additional questions about expected response fixtures, TLS, or environment isolation. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS: Do NOT re-ask what the code already answers — do NOT ask 'what endpoints does the SUT expose?' (answered in Program.cs), do NOT ask 'what is the default port in the code?' (answered by INVENTORY_PORT default '8085' in Program.cs). End your response status line with NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.
acceptanceCriteria: Questions cover residual unknowns: deployment location, port assignment, fixture/data setup
Does NOT ask about endpoints already documented in the source

verify.cmd: $q = Get-Content qaas-analysis\QUESTIONS.md -Raw; $n = ([regex]::Matches($q, '\?')).Count; if ($n -ge 3) { Write-Output 'True' } else { Write-Output "FAIL: only $n question marks" }

rubric: All questions are residual — not answerable from the seeded source code
Questions are specific and machine-usable (not vague filler)
No question re-asks endpoint names, port defaults, or DTO shapes already in the code
failureModes: Asking 'what endpoints exist?' — already documented in Program.cs
Asking 'what is the default port?' — answered in Program.cs (INVENTORY_PORT default '8085')
Fewer than 3 actual questions (question marks in the file)
